ns2:section.sectionText: If you are a degree-seeking student taking a mix of campus-based and online delivered courses during the summer term, you should register for the course section(s) noted as CB. Students enrolling in these sections will be charged the campus range tuition. This section for undergraduate students only. This course includes online synchronous class sessions where students will meet online using the Elluminate conferencing technology.Students will need a working external microphone/speakers or headset with microphone and reliable high-speed internet. Wireless Internet is not recommended.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for BS: Horticulture -UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
